name: bug
description: Something isn't working - Indicates an error, flaw, or failure in the codebase

name: feature-request
description: New feature or enhancement request - Suggests an improvement or new functionality

name: documentation
description: Documentation - Improvements or additions to documentation

name: docker
description: Docker-related - Issues related to Docker setup, configuration, or deployment

name: installation
description: Installation issues - Problems with setup, installation, or initial configuration

name: needs-info
description: Needs more information - Issue requires additional details from the reporter before it can be addressed

name: confirmed
description: Confirmed - Issue has been verified and reproduced by maintainers

name: fixed
description: Fixed - This issue has been resolved and a fix is available

name: duplicate
description: Duplicate - This issue is a duplicate of another issue

name: wontfix
description: Won't fix - This issue will not be resolved for various reasons

name: good-first-issue
description: Good first issue - Good for newcomers - A good issue for first-time contributors

name: help-wanted
description: Help wanted - We need community help with this

name: performance
description: Performance - Performance issues or optimizations needed

name: security
description: Security - Security vulnerability or security-related issue
